AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION

May 26, 2010
7:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Use Permit UP 2010-01 Applicant: Clear Wireless, LLC (Paul Gerst, representative)
Location: 154 N. Aspan Avenue
A request for approval of a Use Permit to allow co-location of three combination panel/parabolic antennas on an existing legal, nonconforming wireless telecommunication facility. The existing telecommunication facility is a mono-pole design, and the proposed co-location will be installed on an existing antenna array. The subject property is located within the West End Light Industrial District (DWL) zone.

A request for approval of Use permit to allow co-location of three combination panel/parabolic antennas on an existing legal, nonconforming wireless telecommunication facility. The existing telecommunication facility is a stealth mono-pine design, and the proposed co-location will be installed on an existing antenna array. The subject property is located with in the West End Industrial District (DW) zone.
